paper_metadata.title: Effect of aging treatment on the microstructure, creep resistance and high-temperature mechanical properties of Mg–6Zn–3Cu alloy with La- and Ce-rich rare earth additions

evidence.quote: alloys based on Mg –Zn–Cu system are of particular interest
Further needs for better performance of Mg –Zn–Cu alloys necessitate the use of other alloying elements such as rare earth (RE) elements
Effect of aging treatment on the microstructure, creep behavior, and high temperature mechanical properties of ZC63 alloy with La- and Ce-rich rare earth additions was investigated.

evidence.quote: Despite its positive effects on creep resistance, the presence of grain boundary network, which is prone to fracture under local stress concentration, promotes the initiation and propagation of cracks, leading to an adverse effect on the shear strength of the material

Aging process increased the volume fractions of eutectic phases and thermally stable Mg –RE compounds. Moreover, the continuous grain boundary network structure was broken and discontinuous participates were formed along grain boundaries.
The creep strength of the investigated alloys was deteriorated as a result of heat treatment, mainly due to the fragmentation of the grain boundary network structure of the cast materials upon aging.
